papers.title: Satellite-based mapping of evapotranspiration, water stress, and crop productivity in mixed irrigated–rainfed agricultural watersheds of central minnesota
papers.authors: Rahimzadegan, M., MULLA, D.J., Runck, B.C., et al.
papers.domain: Clearwater–Elk and Sauk watersheds, central Minnesota, USA
papers.approach: Google Earth Engine SEBAL evapotranspiration, water stress index, and MVI-based yield disaggregation
papers.summary: The study uses a Google Earth Engine SEBAL framework to estimate actual evapotranspiration, water stress, and crop water productivity in mixed irrigated-rainfed Minnesota watersheds from 2021 to 2024.

papers.title: Remote sensing characterisation of agricultural and water use practices in salinity affected canal commands in the Indus Basin Irrigated System (IBIS)
papers.approach: Remote sensing characterisation of cropping and water use in salinity-affected canal commands
papers.summary: Uses remote sensing to characterise agricultural and water use practices in salinity-affected canal commands of the Indus Basin Irrigated System.

papers.title: Regionalising a global gridded crop model using satellite-based phenology for water footprint analysis in the Upper Syr Darya Basin
papers.authors: Baviskar, G.i., Foster, T., Hogeboom, R.J., et al.
papers.domain: Upper Syr Darya Basin, Central Asia
papers.approach: Regionalised global gridded crop model (AquaCrop-Earth@lternatives) with satellite-derived phenology
papers.summary: Regionalises a global crop model's cotton calendar using satellite phenology, showing that planting and season length changes alter simulated evapotranspiration and blue water footprints in the Upper Syr Darya Basin.

papers.title: Alternate Wetting and Drying Irrigated Rice Paddy Field Water Status Monitoring with ALOS-2 Three Components and IoT Sensors
papers.authors: Islam, M.R., Oyoshi, K., Takeuchi, W.
papers.approach: Freeman-Durden decomposition of PALSAR-2 polarimetry with Random Forest classification
papers.summary: Uses L-band PALSAR-2 polarimetric decomposition and IoT water-level sensors with Random Forest to classify alternate wetting and drying versus continuous flooding in rice paddies in Bangladesh.

papers.title: Satellite-Based Spatiotemporal Variability and Mapping the Irrigation Water Requirements of Wheat Crop in Ludhiana District, Punjab
papers.authors: Vullaganti, N., Vashisht, B.B., Kaur, H., et al.
papers.approach: MODIS ET and WorldClim rainfall, IDW interpolation, Sentinel-2 wheat masks, IWR calculation, ANOVA
papers.summary: Satellite-derived evapotranspiration and rainfall are used to map wheat irrigation water requirements across Ludhiana district, Punjab, to support irrigation scheduling.
